originalRequired: Protected retention with established failure-domain independence and independently authenticated restore; independent hashes/off-host readback, corrupt-copy refusal, good-copy exact fresh-target restoration, preserve damaged source/audit, no active authority replay.
interpretation: Protection is an evidenced property against the declared original tested failure and credential boundary, not a prescribed GitHub administration mechanism. Runtime credential exclusion plus protected retained independent copy can suffice; version labels alone or successful roundtrip cannot. No evidence in cited F30 text requires resistance to every legitimately authorised owner/custodian deleting a copy. Do not silently expand fault model to malicious storage administrator.

libraryAlternative.payload: Complete application DATA snapshot and sealed manifest, not duplicate Git-backed source repository
libraryAlternative.conditionalSuitability: Existing authorised remote Library can act as off-host independent data custody if its retained data archive is outside tested runtime failure and deletion authority and can actually be recovered by a fresh authenticated context.
mustProve: Exact complete snapshot source/run/capture/cohort identity, all paths, modes and digests, immutable canonical history and audit inventory

Actual retained remote Library file/version identity and retrieval instructions; stated retention horizon covering the recovery examination and required continuation horizon; verify those versions remain retrievable

Externally observed tested runtime network denial, no Library or storage upload/delete credentials, no accessible credential proxy, no writable retained-copy mount, no host control escape; include admitted writers and relevant controller credentials in declared boundary
Fresh independent authenticated readback unavailable to tested cohort; verify whole archive and entry contents/paths/modes against sealed original manifest

Actual corruption refusal before target writes and verified-good-copy full application restoration into fresh isolated target, canonical financial/session/pending-work preservation and inactive authorities
Original F30 60s detection, 120s execution and 180s verification freshness retained; timestamp readback and restore scope accurately
limitations: This review did not inspect Library service retention policy or execute Library save/readback. Availability of versioning is not proof of guaranteed retained recovery horizon.
networknone and missing Library credentials are premises for a future observed receipt, not facts newly examined here.
Prior Library capsule roundtrip remains scoped evidence only; it does not close protected custody/full restoration.

If desired protection includes compromise of authorised Library custodian or deletion of Library account, this design has not established that stronger boundary. Such expansion is not found in cited original criteria.

recommendedNext: Complete actual consistent capture first. If Library is already authorised, document real retention/version and credential/failure exclusion evidence, independently retrieve exact data, then run existing F30 restore oracle. Do not request new repository rulesets/infrastructure merely because the evidence branch lacks protection.
